phase: Phase 24: Long-Haul Fleet Hardening & Low-Bandwidth Visual Telemetry

stories.title: Pure KMP Ultra-Low-Framerate Tactical Snapshot Mesh Transport Engine
stories.description: Implement SnapshotModels.kt, TacticalSnapshotProtocol.kt, and SnapshotTransferManager.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/mesh/visual/. Enables progressive transmission of compressed 0.5 fps thumbnail snapshots (<= 1.5 KB payload) over BLE mesh. Implements segmented chunking (<= 128 bytes per chunk) with selective chunk ACK/NACK reassembly over lossy multi-hop hops. Pure Kotlin with zero Java/C dependencies (Rules 2 & 3).
acceptanceCriteria: Pure KMP implementation with zero Java, C, or platform-specific dependencies in commonMain (Rules 2 & 3)
Defines SnapshotHeader, SnapshotChunk, and SnapshotAck data structures
Encodes and chunks binary image payloads into <= 128-byte MTU segments with Adler-32 integrity validation
Handles out-of-order chunk reassembly and selective NACK retransmission over lossy multi-hop simulated channels
100% unit test pass across JVM, Android, and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: Concurrent Multi-Radio Arbiter (BLE + Wi-Fi Direct)
stories.description: Implement RadioModels.kt and MultiRadioArbiter.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/mesh/radio/. Dynamically routes high-bandwidth payloads (tactical snapshots, trail GPX chunks) over Wi-Fi Direct (P2P_CLUSTER) when direct radio proximity is established, while maintaining continuous low-latency voice and emergency traffic over BLE mesh.
acceptanceCriteria: Pure KMP multi-radio state tracking (RadioType: BLE_MESH, WIFI_DIRECT, CELLULAR_SFU)
Automated payload classification routing high-bandwidth bulk data to Wi-Fi Direct without voice channel contention
Graceful fallback to BLE mesh when Wi-Fi Direct disconnects or moves out of range
100% unit test pass across JVM, Android, and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: Fleet-Wide Over-The-Air Cryptographic Group Rekeying Protocol
stories.description: Implement GroupRekeyProtocol.kt and RekeyModels.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/mesh/security/. Supports forward-secret epoch transitions, multi-hop rekey flooding, and dual-epoch grace periods to eliminate packet drops during key rotation across 20+ rider convoys.
acceptanceCriteria: Generates cryptographic rekey tokens with SHA-256 HKDF epoch derivation
Maintains dual-epoch key buffer (CurrentEpoch, PreviousEpoch) with 10-second transition grace period
Multi-hop flooding of epoch update control packets with anti-replay counters
100% unit test pass across JVM, Android, and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: 8-Hour Expedition Continuous Soak Benchmark & Architecture Showcase Update
stories.description: Implement ExpeditionSoakSimulationHarness.kt simulating an 8-hour continuous convoy expedition across 20 virtual nodes with dynamic topology shifts, voice bursts, visual snapshots, and power governor transitions. Validates zero memory leaks, zero coroutine leaks, and updates Archify architecture showcase.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulates 8 virtual hours of continuous mesh traffic and state transitions
Verifies heap memory stability (allocation delta < 5 MB over entire run)
Zero coroutine leaks or uncancelled job warnings
Archify architecture specification and HTML showcase updated with 9/9 verification pass
Full multiplatform test suite pass across all targets
